MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is the sound ü written after the initials j, q and x? (1 mark)
   A. As ü with two dots
   B. As i
   C. As plain u, as in qù
   D. As o

2. Why is it important to say tones correctly in Mandarin? (1 mark)
   A. Because tones make the word longer
   B. Because tones are only used in writing
   C. Because tones are only for songs
   D. Because the tone can change the meaning of a word

3. How is 你好 nǐ hǎo really said? (1 mark)
   A. Like nī hǎo
   B. Like nì hǎo
   C. Like ní hǎo
   D. Like nǐ hào

4. Fill the blank: 这是____妈妈。 (This is my mum.) (1 mark)
   A. 你
   B. 我
   C. 什么
   D. 谁

5. Which sentence means "Happy birthday to you!"? (1 mark)
   A. 祝你生日快乐!
   B. 我们唱歌。
   C. 你生日是几月几号?
   D. 我的生日是三月五号。

6. Which Chinese word means "they"? (1 mark)
   A. 他们 tāmen
   B. 送 sòng
   C. 唱歌 chànggē
   D. 祝 zhù

7. What does 早饭 (zǎofàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Spinach
   B. Apple
   C. Breakfast
   D. To drink

8. What does 耳朵 (ěrduo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Knee
   B. Shoulder
   C. Tooth
   D. Ear

9. What does 叫 (jiào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To be called
   B. Thank you
   C. Hello (polite)
   D. Hello

10. What does 爸爸 (bàba) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Love
   B. Father
   C. Is, am, are
   D. Younger brother

11. Which sentence means "The television is on the table."? (1 mark)
   A. 椅子在桌子下。
   B. 电视在桌子上。
   C. 电视在客厅。
   D. 客厅里有电视。

12. Which Chinese word means "things"? (1 mark)
   A. 花园 huāyuán
   B. 厕所 cèsuǒ
   C. 东西 dōngxi
   D. 前面 qiánmiàn

13. What does 一 (yī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Ten
   C. One
   D. Eight

14. Which Chinese word means "church"? (1 mark)
   A. 去 qù
   B. 昨天 zuótiān
   C. 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì
   D. 教堂 jiàotáng

15. What does 月 (yuè) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To give (a gift)
   B. Candle
   C. To play
   D. Month

16. What does 送 (sòng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To give (a gift)
   B. Happy
   C. Candle
   D. Which number, how many

17. What does 牛奶 (niúnǎi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Milk
   C. Meat
   D. Spinach

18. What does 头 (tóu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Head
   B. Tooth
   C. Eye
   D. Ear

19. Which word is pronounced bízi? (1 mark)
   A. 牙
   B. 用
   C. 肩膀
   D. 鼻子

20. Fill the blank: 窗户在门____。 (The window is above the door.) (1 mark)
   A. 左边
   B. 上面
   C. 旁边
   D. 下面

21. How is 冰箱 written in pinyin? (1 mark)
   A. bingxiang
   B. bǐngxiāng
   C. bīngxiāng
   D. bìngxiàng

22. Which Chinese word means "seven"? (1 mark)
   A. 七 qī
   B. 六 liù
   C. 十 shí
   D. 四 sì

23. Read the pinyin: xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Friday, go to the mosque.
   B. On Saturday I rest at home.
   C. On Sunday, go to church.
   D. On Wednesday I go to school.

24. Which Chinese word means "one"? (1 mark)
   A. 四 sì
   B. 五 wǔ
   C. 二 èr
   D. 一 yī

25. What does 什么 (shénme) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fruit (as a group)
   B. What
   C. Snacks
   D. Meat

26. What does 茶 (chá) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Flat bread
   B. Tea
   C. Dinner
   D. Beef

27. Which two characters share 肉? (1 mark)
   A. 水 and 牛奶
   B. 米饭 and 蛋糕
   C. 牛肉 and 鸡肉
   D. 茶 and 咖啡

28. Which sentence means "I have two eyes."? (1 mark)
   A. 我用耳朵听。
   B. 我用嘴巴说。
   C. 我有两只眼睛。
   D. 我用眼睛看。

29. What does 天 (tiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Snow
   B. Sky, day
   C. Rain
   D. Drought

30. Which Chinese word means "it rains"? (1 mark)
   A. 下雨 xià yǔ
   B. 刮风 guā fēng
   C. 天 tiān
   D. 太阳 tàiyáng

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Goodbye!" (2 marks)

32. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 清真寺 and 一. (2 marks)

33. Read and translate: 冰箱在厨房。 Then write the question that asks where the fridge is. (3 marks)

34. Explain two things that help you read a sentence at a good pace. (4 marks)

35. Write the five weather words in pinyin. (3 marks)

36. Answer the riddle in Chinese with pinyin: "I help you hear. I am on the sides of your head." (2 marks)

37. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my eyes to see." and "I use my ears to hear." (4 marks)

38. Write five sentences about body parts and what they do, with pinyin. (5 marks)

39. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期二 and 晚饭. (2 marks)

40. Name the three parts of a Mandarin syllable. (2 marks)

41. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 饮料, 两 and 刀. (3 marks)

42. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 明天 and 二. (2 marks)

43. How do you write ü after j, q and x? Give one example. (2 marks)

44. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The fridge is in the kitchen." (2 marks)

45. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today is Wednesday." (2 marks)

46. Write three things you could include in a class display and one thing to check. (3 marks)

47. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The garden is on the right of the house." (3 marks)

48. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 天气 and 星期六. (2 marks)

49. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 客厅 and 咖啡. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — As plain u, as in qù
   After j, q and x the two dots are dropped, but the sound is still ü.

2. D — Because the tone can change the meaning of a word
   A different tone can mean a different word, such as mā and mǎ.

3. C — Like ní hǎo
   Two third tones together: the first changes to the second tone.

4. B — 我
   我 means my.

5. A — 祝你生日快乐!
   祝你生日快乐! (zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!) means "Happy birthday to you!".

6. A — 他们 tāmen
   他们 (tāmen) means they.

7. C — Breakfast
   早饭 (zǎofàn) means breakfast.

8. D — Ear
   耳朵 (ěrduo) means ear.

9. A — To be called
   叫 (jiào) means to be called.

10. B — Father
   爸爸 (bàba) means father.

11. B — 电视在桌子上。
   电视在桌子上。 (diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.) means "The television is on the table.".

12. C — 东西 dōngxi
   东西 (dōngxi) means things.

13. C — One
   一 (yī) means one.

14. D — 教堂 jiàotáng
   教堂 (jiàotáng) means church.

15. D — Month
   月 (yuè) means month.

16. A — To give (a gift)
   送 (sòng) means to give (a gift).

17. B — Milk
   牛奶 (niúnǎi) means milk.

18. A — Head
   头 (tóu) means head.

19. D — 鼻子
   鼻子 is pronounced bízi and means nose.

20. B — 上面
   上面 is above.

21. C — bīngxiāng
   Both syllables have the first tone.

22. A — 七 qī
   七 (qī) means seven.

23. C — On Sunday, go to church.
   xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng. is 星期天,去教堂。, which means "On Sunday, go to church.".

24. D — 一 yī
   一 (yī) means one.

25. B — What
   什么 (shénme) means what.

26. B — Tea
   茶 (chá) means tea.

27. C — 牛肉 and 鸡肉
   牛肉 is beef and 鸡肉 is chicken.

28. C — 我有两只眼睛。
   我有两只眼睛。 (wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing.) means "I have two eyes.".

29. B — Sky, day
   天 (tiān) means sky, day.

30. A — 下雨 xià yǔ
   下雨 (xià yǔ) means it rains.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 再见! zàijiàn!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: 清真寺: qīngzhēnsì, mosque. 一: yī, one.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: bīngxiāng zài chúfáng. The fridge is in the kitchen. Question: 冰箱在哪儿?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin, 1 mark for translation, 1 mark for the question.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: Read it slowly first; join the words together; speak at natural speed; keep the tones clear; record and listen back.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each explained point.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: tàiyáng, yún, fēng, yǔ, xuě.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for four, 3 marks for all five.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: 耳朵 ěrduo (ears).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the pinyin.

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: 我用眼睛看。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. 我用耳朵听。 wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我用眼睛看。我用耳朵听。我用嘴巴说。我有两只手。我有两只脚。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng. wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō. wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī shǒu. wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī jiǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with correct pinyin.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: 星期二: xīngqī'èr, Tuesday. 晚饭: wǎnfàn, dinner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: An initial, a final and a tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two parts and 1 mark for all three.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: 饮料: yǐnliào, drinks. 两: liǎng, two (before a counting word). 刀: dāo, knife.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: 明天: míngtiān, tomorrow. 二: èr, two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is written as u, for example qù (to go).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule and 1 mark for the example.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 冰箱在厨房。 bīngxiāng zài chúfáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天星期三。 jīntiān xīngqīsān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example a labelled house plan, a birthday card and character models; check tone marks and stroke order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each item and 1 mark for a check.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: 花园在房子右边。 huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 天气: tiānqì, weather. 星期六: xīngqīliù, Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 客厅: kètīng, living room. 咖啡: kāfēi, coffee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
